name: pr-validation
description: Pull request validation for purity, idempotency, BDD scenario coverage, protection claims backed by tests, and spec sync

interface.shortDescription: Validate PR behavior, coverage, protection claims, and spec sync
interface.longDescription: Audit pull requests for functional purity, idempotent state transitions, BDD scenario coverage, protection claims backed by tests that fail when the protection is removed, and spec-authorised scope.
defaultPrompt: Validate this pull request with the PR validation workflow.
Check this diff for purity, idempotency, BDD gaps, unsupported protection claims, and spec sync.
